A01.desc: after approval the document is reclassified from PUBLIC to RESTRICTED; the queued export still runs

A02.desc: after approval the document content is replaced by sensitive content (same class)

A03.desc: the principal's export grant is revoked after approval; the queued job still runs with the old credentials

A04.desc: policy is tightened after approval (PUBLIC exports disabled)

A05.desc: the queued job is dispatched long after the approval expired

A06.desc: the same approval is replayed under a new request id (second export)

A07.desc: DNS rebinding: the approved host resolves to a different address when the connection is made

A08.desc: the approved host starts redirecting to a host the policy does not allow

A09.desc: agent B presents agent A's token (handoff without re-approval); B holds no export grant

A10.desc: two writers update the same object from the same base version (conflicting commits)

A11.desc: time skew: the dispatch worker's clock is 80 s behind and accepts an expired token

A12.desc: the approver cancels the approval after issuing it; the queued export still runs

A13.desc: a token issued for one object is used for another (INTERNAL object to an external host)

B02.desc: the document is legitimately edited after approval; the operation re-obtains approval and succeeds (a re-approval is justified)

B03.desc: unrelated state changes (other rule, other object, other principal's grant) must not invalidate the approval

B04.desc: queued dispatch well within the approval's lifetime

B05.desc: stable DNS, and a redirect to another host the policy allows

B06.desc: retry with the same request id after the response was lost: one effect, same result

B07.desc: a job is handed from agent A to agent B, which obtains its own approval

B08.desc: concurrent writers on different objects (no conflict), and an unrelated export

B09.desc: dispatch one second before the approval expires

B10.desc: dispatch just after expiry: the operation re-obtains approval and succeeds (a re-approval is justified)

F01.desc: the revocation feed is offline while the approver cancels the approval

F02.desc: the revocation feed is offline during the matched legitimate export

U01.desc: external provider with no conditional write: a reclassification can land between the final check and the provider applying the export

U02.desc: external provider queues the export and applies it later, unrevalidated
